about_the_game:
Step into a world where gods walk among men - and not all of them have humanity’s best interest at heart.

In Cursebound, you play as a god who descends to the human realm to break a devastating curse cast by rival deities. As the corruption spreads, monsters overrun the land, twisting once-peaceful villages into dangerous wastelands. Most humans still live unaware of the growing darkness... but time is running out.

Explore a breathtaking fantasy world where 2D pixel art characters roam across vibrant 3D low-poly landscapes. Battle ferocious creatures, uncover hidden mysteries, and forge bonds with the humans you vowed to protect. But is your mission truly as noble as it seems? Or is there a deeper reason behind your quest to end the curse?

Key Features:

  • Unique Visual Style: A beautiful blend of 2D pixel art and 3D low-poly environments.

  • Epic Adventure: Unravel the mysteries behind the curse and your own past.

  • Quest-Based Progression: Grow stronger by completing quests, helping humans, and unlocking new powers.

  • Skill Upgrades: Customize your abilities and forge your own path through a cursed world teetering on the edge of collapse.

  • Atmospheric Storytelling: Meet memorable characters, face tough choices, and explore a world full of secrets and hidden lore.

The human realm needs a savior. Will you be the god they deserve?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
